title: Pattern Matching with LIKE and Wildcards
realWorldScenario: Customer support needs to find all customers registered with an @example.com email address.
questionStatement: Write a query to return the `id`, `name`, and `email` of all customers whose `email` ends with `@example.com`, ordered by `id` ascending.
starterCode:
-- Find customers with example.com emails
SELECT id, name, email
FROM customers
WHERE email LIKE '%@example.com'
ORDER BY id ASC;
hints: The % wildcard matches zero or more characters before the string.

testCases.description: Verify customers matching email domain wildcard
